svg.title: British Columbia Place — early-1980s monogram — geometric reconstruction
svg.desc: Modern researched reconstruction, made 2026-11-03. Documented historical uses: Gulf Islands Driftwood, 22 September 1982, p. 6; BC Place Grand Opening Gala programme, 19 June 1983, p. 4 (Canadian Museum of History). Hand-built circles, arcs and custom outlined lettering; no raster tracing, embedded image, live font or recovered original vector master. Designer, exact introduction date and production colour specification unknown.
